note: Decisions on PS2 infill conflicts (sheet row vs the name PS2 Ghidra holds at that address), 25 Sept 2026. 'sheet': the sheet name is canonical and the Ghidra name is the same function under another name (a spelling, an SDK alias, a template written out, or a guess made while reading code). 'reject': the infill placement is wrong. 'open': for the user to decide. 'address': the row's true PS2 address, overriding the sheet's own and any name match (from the audit, 25 Sept 2026).
